notes: The two 'cannot's are treated as fused negation-plus-modal on לֹא, following rule 48's explicit treatment of that word; the subject pronouns stay with their verbs.

'neither is it' is read as one waw+אַיִן fusion under rule 35 with rule 50's presentative frame, headed on the negation; the note on that unit names the alternative that gives 'neither' to the waw alone.
גַם is unrepresented — the ASV writes no 'also' for it — and the object marker אוֹת takes the 'in' that exists only to attach its object (rule 16).
